13720.html:
13720 stōká m. 'drop' RV., stōkam adv. 'gradually, a little' MBh. [√*stu²]
    Pa. thōka- n. 'trifle', adj. 'small, insignificant', °aka-; Pk. thōga-, thōa-, thōva-, thōvāga- 'little, a little'; OG. thova 'gradually'; — ext. -ḍ-: Woṭ. thōṛḗg 'a little, few', Sv. thoṛṓᵘ, K.ḍoḍ. thōṛō, P. thoṛā, ḍog. thoṛ m. 'scarcity'; WPah.bhad. thōṛō, paṅ. cur. thoṛā 'a little, few', jaun. thōṛō 'short'; Ku. thoṛo 'a little, few', N. thor, B. Or. thoṛā, Bi. thor, Mth. thoṛ, Bhoj. thōr, Aw.lakh. thōrā, H. thoṛā (whence thuṛnā 'to fall short'), Marw. thoṛo, G. thoṛũ, M. thoḍā; — -l-: S. thoro 'small, few', L. thōlā.
    stṓkya-, *stōkra-.
    Addenda: stōká-: WPah.kṭg. (kc.) thóṛɔ 'a little, small, short (e.g. of time)'; Garh. thoṛā 'little' (← H.?).

9289.html:
9289 *bura 'defective'. 2. *bōra-¹. [Cf. *bhōra-: see list s.v. *bukka- ⁴]
    1. S. buro 'noseless, bad'; P. burā 'wicked'; WPah. bhad. buro 'ugly, bad', bhal. buro 'bad', burṛi f. 'sheep with small ears', paṅ. cam. burā 'bad', cur. būrā; Ku. N. buro 'wicked'; Or. burā 'inferior, improper'; H. burā 'bad, wicked', G. būrũ, M. burā.
    2. Or. borā 'wicked'.
    *burakāra-.
    Addenda: *bura-: WPah.kṭg. burɔ 'bad, wicked', J. burā, Garh. buru; Ko. buro 'scrotum'.

9408.html:
9408 bhalla¹ 'auspicious' lex. [< *bhadla- ~ bhadrá-¹: bhalla- is rustic according to Vāmana (Regnaud Rhét. Sanskrite 141). — NIA. forms have abnormal shortening of -ll- or later of -ā- in a word for 'good']
    Pk. bhalla-, °aya- 'good', Woṭ. bal; Sv. bhālo 'good, true'; K. bolᵘ 'recovered in health' (or < bála-); S. bhalu m. 'goodness', bhalo 'good', m. 'advantage'; L. bhalā 'well', mult. bhall 'however, but', bhallā 'well', awāṇ. bhallā 'good'; P. bhalā 'good', vhalā adv. 'then, in that case'; WPah. (Joshi) bhalā 'good', bhalnu 'to get well'; Ku. bhal, bhalo 'good', N. bhalo; A. bhāl 'nice, proper, pleasing, auspicious'; B. bhāla 'good', Or. bhala, bhalā; Mth. bhāl, bhal 'beautiful'; Bhoj. Aw. lakh. H. bhalā, OMarw. bhalaü, f. bhālī, OG. bhalaü, G. bhalũ adj., n. 'welfare', (bhāḷũ adv. 'well' cf. bhala RV.?); M. bhalā 'good'.
    *bhallatara-.
    bhalla-² 'bear' see bhallū́ka-¹.
    Addenda: bhalla-¹: S.kcch. bhalo 'good'; WPah.kṭg. bhɔˋlɔ 'good, proper', Garh. bhalu, f. °li.

7150.html:
7150 niktá 'washed, purified' RV. [√nij]
    Wg. nĩtə- 'bald', Dm. nitói; — replaced in MIA. by *nikka-: Pk. ṇikka- 'clear'; Woṭ. nik 'thin'; K. nyukᵘ, f. nicᷴ 'fine, small' (whence nikun 'to become small'), ḍoḍ. nikko 'small'; L. P. nikkā 'small, young', awāṇ. nik 'shortness', khet. nikṛā 'small', nikī aṅgəl 'third finger'; WPah.bhad. nikṛo 'small', bhal. nikki lo f. 'early dawn', nikṛo 'younger', cur. nikkā 'small'; Ku. niko 'good, kind', gng. nik; N. niko 'healthy, well'; A. nikā 'clean'; B. nikā 'to wipe, plaster with cowdung'; Or. nika 'fine and clean (only of rice)', nikā 'sweeping a house clean', nikāibā 'to cleanse'; Mth. nĭ̄k 'good', nikāh, Aw.lakh. nīk; H. nīkā 'good, beautiful' (nekā infl. by Pers. nēk); OMarw. nīkā adv. 'well'; G. nīkũ 'clear, pure, fine'; M. nikā 'pure, good'. — See *nigna-.
    *anikta-; *niktāṅga-.
    Addenda: niktá-: A. nikāiba 'to cleanse' AFD 337.

5654.html:
5654 tanú 'thin, delicate' ŚBr., tánuka- Pāṇ. [√tan]
    Pa. tanu-, °uka- 'thin, small', Pk. taṇu-, °ua-; K. tonᵘ 'thin'; Ku. taṇuwā̃ 'sparsely, thinly'; A. tanū 'thin'; Si. tunu 'thin, fine'; — H. tanuk, °nak, °nik 'small'. — Kho. tonuk 'thin, delicate' ← Pers. tanuk Morgenstierne BSOS viii 670. See Add.
    tanula-.
    tanuja- see tanūjá-.
    Addenda: tanú-: Md. tuni 'thin'.
    †tanūbhūta-.
